text:
maria-marketing: Quick prod ask — we need a small stratified microcohort to back a blog/webinar claim for launch. Minimal but defensible artifacts only.

maria-marketing: Target: 5k total requests, stratified by seq-length bins (up to 2048), 4 RNG seeds, steady 20 qps (to mimic demo traffic), report p50/p90/p95/p99 and 95% bootstrap CI. Also per-token cost delta (fp16 vs q2_k), a CSV of raw latencies, and a couple heatmaps. Deadline: Thu 12:00 PT. Is that feasible? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

sam-runtime: Can do. Quick clarifying Qs: which exact model binary (open-v2.0?), which quant preset (q2_k?), and do you want kernel/fallback logging? Also which infra pool to run on?

maria-marketing: Yes to open-v2.0. Use q2_k for quant. Please log kernel selection and any fallback (e.g., fp16 fallback if quant path fails) — marketing may call that out. Use bench-pool-medium. Warmup: 100 prefix warmups per worker.

nina-eng: Add request to log prefix-cache hits and any KV reuse metric. If possible include a 3-line perf.conf snippet we can paste in the blog.

sam-runtime: Noted. Perf snippet I'll include. Plan: stratified sample proportions: 128(50%), 512(30%), 1024(15%), 2048(5%). Seeds: 7,13,99,2021. Will run 5k across seeds (approx 1250 per seed) and post interim artifacts. Expect ~90m on bench-pool-medium.

bench-bot: scheduled run: stratified-1831234000 on bench-pool-medium will start at 1831237600 UTC (owner: sam-runtime).

sam-runtime: Kickoff at 1831237600. I'll stream short updates here. If we hit quota I'll reduce to 3k and re-run later.

maria-marketing: If you have to reduce samples, prioritize keeping the 2048 bin unchanged. That bin is the narrative risk.

sam-runtime: Interim update (seed=13): p95 for 2048 = 560ms, q2_k token-cost delta = -6.4% (cheaper), but top-1 token mismatch in 2048 bin = 0.72%. Logging sample diffs for any bin >0.5%.

lisa-analytics: FYI I'll compute bootstrap CIs from the CSV once uploaded. If mismatch >0.5% in any bin, we need 200 token-level examples and mismatch_pct per bin. I'll prepare chart templates.

sam-runtime: Will attach mismatch_snippets.md with token diffs and per-bin summary. Perf snippet queued:

```
# perf.conf (excerpt)
batching.enabled=true
batch.max_tokens=4096
warmup.requests=100
log.kernel_select=true
quantize.profile=q2_k
```

nina-eng: Also capture kernel_name in traces (eg attention_fast32), and count fallback_to_fp16 events.

sam-runtime: Adding kernel_name and fallback counters to run metadata.

sam-runtime: Full artifacts uploaded: /shared/marketing/benchpacks/stratified-1831234000/artifacts_v1.tar.gz — contains raw_latencies.csv, heatmap_long.png, heatmap_short.png, perf.conf, runbook.md, mismatch_snippets.md, run_metadata.json.

lisa-analytics: Pulled files. Early headline: overall mean token-cost -5.7% for q2_k, 95p latencies within demo bounds except the 2048 tail where p99 spikes; bootstrap CI attached. I pushed charts to the folder.

maria-marketing: Thanks. Because mismatch in 2048 is ~0.7% we will call out the caveat in the blog and avoid using 2048 in the primary claim. Please keep the example token diffs handy in case press asks.

sam-runtime: Noted. I'll prepare a tiny FAQ blurb about mismatch causes (quantization vs long-context sampling) and drop it in the folder.

maria-marketing: Great work team — I'll update the launch checklist and share draft copy for review. :sparkles:
